primary_scientific_question: Which low-dimensional change can improve monthly TN dynamics after water quantity, quick/groundwater partitioning and hydrologic state are fixed to Q72?
spatial_boundary: LOSO and LOTO are diagnostic and must be nested; no claim of reliable 230-Reach extrapolation is allowed unless a separate absolute spatial-skill gate passes.

frozen_core.geometry_role: static reach length and Andreadis width/depth; Andreadis reference discharge forbidden
frozen_core.legacy_requirement: a persistent N-memory concept remains in the core, but F2 may test an equal-complexity relocation of the existing memory
frozen_core.formal_members: S0 and S1-12 crossed with mu={12,36,60,96,144,240}
frozen_core.source_timing: agricultural reconstruction remains annual/12; this is an input limitation, not observed monthly availability

upgrade_rule.absolute_noninferiority: paired simultaneous CI95 upper < 0.005 log1p unit
upgrade_rule.member_consistency: >=10 of 12 members anomaly point-improved and absolute noninferior
upgrade_rule.multiple_testing: paired station blocks with Westfall-Young max-T across the registered candidate family

claim_boundary: A better likelihood or P2 readout is a monitored-station prediction upgrade, not evidence that a new nitrogen process has been identified. Internal Legacy stocks and fitted lags remain effective model states unless constrained by independent soil, vadose-zone, groundwater or tracer observations.
